gauge-stroke-ratio.$description: ring stroke as a fraction of the ring's diameter: a 170 px ring gets an 8.5 px stroke (ADR-0030 §2.5)

accent.$description: the one attention KPI tile; content is ink (8.4:1)

accent-strong.$description: white text at the large tier only: >= 24 px regular or >= 19 px bold (3.05:1, ADR-0011)

inverse.$description: active segmented button, send button; black glyph

inverse-media.$description: the white solid of visual-dna principle 9 on vivid: Button primary and the active segment when the published material is vivid (ADR-0030 §3.1)

page.$description: never pure #000; optional radial vignette +3-10% toward the hero

default.$description: surface-1 = #1C1C1F over page; no border, no shadow

nested.$description: surface-3 = #2A2B2E: translucent card over map, control on card

raised.$description: surface-2 = #232426: tiles, pills, nested; optional 1 px white 8% top edge on tiles and nav pills only

accent.$description: orange band under a flagged chart window (= #2D2118 on page)

boundary.$description: control edges that must pass 3:1: white 36% gives 3.30:1 on page and 3.18:1 on surface-3 (visual-dna B2)

on-glass-fill.$description: rings and outlines on the scheme's glass; decorative, next to a label or glyph (ADR-0030 §3.2)

on-media.$description: rings and outlines on vivid; decorative, next to a label or glyph (ADR-0030 §3.2)

line.$description: chart line on the scheme's glass: white on smoke in dark (ADR-0030 §2.3)

plot.$description: the plot on the scheme's glass: a white 8% lift (ADR-0030 §2.3)

reference.$description: the target or reference line on the scheme's glass (ADR-0030 §2.3; ADR-0007 rule 2)
the target or reference line on vivid, told apart from the line by stroke.target's dash (ADR-0030 §2.2; ADR-0007 rule 2)

plot.$description: charts never sit on raw glass

highlight.$description: the glass edge, drawn at the recipe's edge.start and edge.end alphas, and the vivid highlight at material.vivid.edge.* (ADR-0030 §4.1, §4.2)

raised.$description: the 1 px top edge of raised: tiles and nav pills (ADR-0030 §4.1)

block.$description: map ground: city blocks, over the land

building.$description: map ground: buildings, over the land

label.$description: map labels, with a halo of color.map.land at 2 x border.strong (ADR-0030 §1.4); functional on every ground

land.$description: map ground: the land, the page (ADR-0030 §1.1)

park.$description: map ground: parks, over the land

road.$description: map ground: roads; a major road is road at a wider stroke over road-casing (ADR-0030 §1.3)

road-casing.$description: map ground: the casing under roads

route.$description: the ridden route, 2 x chart.line-width over route-casing (ADR-0030 §1.4)

route-ahead.$description: the route ahead, 1.5 x chart.line-width, dashed with stroke.target (ADR-0030 §1.4)

route-casing.$description: the casing under the route lines, 3.5 x chart.line-width (ADR-0030 §1.4)

water.$description: map ground: water, over the land; hue never carries status on the map (ADR-0030 §1.2)

accent.$description: 7.4:1 on surface-1; text allowed at >= 12 px

dimmed.$description: 4.04:1 / 3.79:1: trailing digits and units >= 24 pt only (reference 35-40% was 2.3-2.9:1)

on-accent-secondary.$description: the lit tile's second tone: on-accent at 70% for the secondary, tertiary and dimmed tones of the accent material (ADR-0030 §3.4)

on-glass.$description: white on dark glass; light glass uses on-glass-light (ADR-0022)

on-glass-fill.$description: the scheme's glass (material.glass.fill and .chip): white on smoked glass in dark (ADR-0029 §1.3)

on-glass-fill-dimmed.$description: dimmed tone on the scheme's glass over Prism's map: white 64% (ADR-0029 §1.4)

on-glass-fill-media-secondary.$description: secondary tone on the scheme's glass over imagery and vivid: white 78% in dark (ADR-0029 §1.4)

on-glass-fill-media-tertiary.$description: tertiary and dimmed tones on the scheme's glass over imagery and vivid: white 64% in dark (ADR-0029 §1.4)

on-glass-fill-secondary.$description: secondary tone on the scheme's glass over Prism's map: white 78% (ADR-0029 §1.4)

on-glass-fill-tertiary.$description: tertiary tone on the scheme's glass over Prism's map: white 64% (ADR-0029 §1.4)

on-glass-light.$description: white on light glass in the dark scheme; hierarchy by size, never by alpha (ADR-0022 §3)

on-glass-secondary.$description: secondary tone on dark glass (the glass material) only; chips and cells use on-glass (ADR-0022 §3)

on-glass-tertiary.$description: tertiary and dimmed tones on dark glass (the glass material) only (ADR-0022 §3)

on-inverse-media.$description: ink on the white solid over vivid (bg.fill.inverse-media; ADR-0030 §3.1)

on-vivid.$description: every vivid gradient, the nine reference gradients included, passes ADR-0022 V1/V2

primary.$description: numerals pure white; body may use #F5F6F8

tertiary.$description: 5.96:1 / 5.39:1: axis labels, timestamps (reference 45-50% failed on surface-3)

weight.$description: regular; maps to Phosphor regular / SF regular (spec/icons/registry.json)

default.$description: status cells over a render; smoked fill (ADR-0022 F10), primary foreground text.on-glass only; a 1.5 px status border carries the status
the scheme's glass for chips, controls and status cells over media; aliases glass.dark.chip field by field (ADR-0029 §1.2)
controls over map, render or vivid; smoked, since white tints fail over light backdrops (ADR-0022 F10); primary foreground text.on-glass only
panel / sheet / card over map; takes the backdrop hue
the scheme's glass: Surface glass and Card glass over maps, imagery and vivid; aliases glass.dark.fill field by field (ADR-0029 §1.2)
the selected / foreground object; only over imagery or maps at OKLCH L <= 0.35, never over vivid; text uses text.on-glass-light; bloom clipped away from text (ADR-0022)

scrim.$description: modal backdrop dim; bottom-up text scrim over bright photos: large white text holds 3:1 over it on pure white (ADR-0029 §1.7); maps need no scrim

end.$description: alpha of color.edge.highlight at the end of a vivid surface's inner edge (ADR-0030 §4.2)

start.$description: alpha of color.edge.highlight at the start of a vivid surface's 1 px inner edge (ADR-0030 §4.2)

crossfade.$description: Flag. 1 under Reduce Motion: outside an active gesture nothing scales, rotates, blurs or changes depth; presentations fade by opacity over motion.duration.base with motion.easing.out; in-place movement keeps its spring (ADR-0023 §8.4).

min.$description: minimum card width in pattern grids (spec/patterns/README.md)

font-family.$description: the hero numeral; the watch platform context uses ref.type.metric.xl-watch (ADR-0030 §7.2)

font-size.$description: the hero numeral; the watch platform context uses ref.type.metric.xl-watch (ADR-0030 §7.2)

font-weight.$description: the hero numeral; the watch platform context uses ref.type.metric.xl-watch (ADR-0030 §7.2)

line-height.$description: the hero numeral; the watch platform context uses ref.type.metric.xl-watch (ADR-0030 §7.2)

letter-spacing.$description: the hero numeral; the watch platform context uses ref.type.metric.xl-watch (ADR-0030 §7.2)

pressed.$description: the ghost is outlined and transparent at rest; pressed takes the neutral subtle fill (ADR-0029 §3.3)

rest.$description: solid inverse pill is the only fill
